evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and possession of capability as the appealed-to good, directly naming autonomy and the standing that comes from owning rather than renting.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination (what you keep is yours) and to the craft-level capability that produces a distinctive perspective.
The phrase names self-origination of intelligence as a thesis being advanced, appealing to autonomy as the value the document positions around.
